findings.title: Declared return type omits the bare selector string returned for searchableJson selectors
findings.label: valid
findings.note: encryptQuery is typed EncryptedQuery|null with no string arm, but the docblock and the e2e test confirm that searchableJson selectors return a bare string.

findings.title: JSON containment/selector terms never matched against a real EQL database
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The WASM adapter's SUPPORTED_OPS is scalar-only and the Deno suite only checks JSON term shapes, so the newly documented JSON containment/selector SQL is never row-matched.

findings.title: Public guidance invites logging query terms that leak equality/order relationships
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new docblock does say terms are safe to log-scrub less aggressively, yet deterministic HMAC/ORE terms leak equality and order relationships.
